name: Software Product Landscape

sourcePin.snapshotRule: Digest is over the canonical JSON serialization of the eleven frozen layer documents.

purpose: Represent a governed time-aware software product landscape, typed cross-product dependencies, explicit completeness and reproducible impact results without copying product identity or internals.

owns: landscape identity and immutable scope versions
impact-query request identity and reproducible result evidence
delegates: software-product identity and lifecycle to the referenced product master
product internals to pinned AISMM product contexts
deployment and runtime facts to their domain masters
capability, process, organization, risk and portfolio identity to external masters
tenant-scoped managed-service semantics to WM-XCT-039 when explicitly referenced
excludes: copies of requirements architecture code deployment or runtime facts
automatic promotion of inferred or scenario edges
compatibility claims based only on equal version labels

bundles.name: Product membership
bundles.semantics: Landscape identity, scope, temporal membership and authoritative product references.

bundles.name: Product relationships
bundles.semantics: Typed dependency, integration, event and data-flow edges between memberships.

bundles.name: Capability projection
bundles.semantics: Read-only capability-to-product mappings whose capability master stays external.

bundles.name: Cross-product process projection
bundles.semantics: Read-only process participation and routing references.

bundles.name: Operations projection
bundles.semantics: References to external deployment, runtime, observation, incident and SLA masters.

bundles.name: Governance projection
bundles.semantics: References to external owner, mandate, risk and compliance masters.

bundles.name: AISMM federation
bundles.semantics: Pinned product-to-AISMM references and exposed-projection declarations.

bundles.name: Change and evolution
bundles.semantics: Non-destructive replacement, deprecation and migration assertions.

bundles.name: Consistency and trust
bundles.semantics: Coverage, staleness, provenance, validation state and unknown-boundary declarations.

bundles.name: Semantic routing
bundles.semantics: Reproducible traversal request and result semantics.

pinPolicy.canonicalEdge: Both endpoint product versions and every referenced AISMM context must provide immutable identifier, commit or version, and content digest.
pinPolicy.aismm: No universal AISMM tag is imposed. Each membership pins the exact product-context commit and digest it actually uses; a tag may be recorded as descriptive evidence.
pinPolicy.unresolved: Unpinned or stale references remain visible but are excluded from canonical impact answers.

relations.purpose: Resolve pinned product-internal context without copying it or claiming global compatibility.
Resolve an optional tenant-scoped managed-service projection without importing service or asset mastership.

operations.effect: Issue an immutable scope version for one landscape.
Assert temporal participation of one authoritative product version.
operations.authority: landscape steward or delegated product owner

operations.effect: End membership validity through a tombstone while retaining history.
Assert one typed evidenced edge between pinned memberships.
Produce a reproducible result with traversal parameters, exclusions and coverage limits.

invariants: A membership references exactly one authoritative product identity and never creates a second SoftwareProduct.
Product internals are referenced through immutable pins and are never copied into PLMM.
A dependency connects memberships in one landscape scope version rather than unversioned raw product names.
Every canonical dependency pins both endpoint product versions and records evidence plus authority.
Unpinned, stale, inferred or scenario edges remain visible but are excluded from canonical impact answers.
Membership and dependency withdrawal is non-destructive and preserves predecessor evidence.
A query result pins landscape scope, as-of time, start nodes, relation filter, depth and cycle policy.
Every result reports missing, stale, unknown and excluded coverage; an empty graph never means zero impact.
Traversal over the same pinned scope and parameters yields the same evidence digest.
Capability, process, organization, risk, deployment and portfolio identities remain external masters.
An AISMM version label alone never proves content compatibility; exact content evidence is required.
WM-XCT-039 references do not confer tenant, service or asset mastership on PLMM.
Access to a landscape result cannot exceed access to its contributing evidence.
Retired products and withdrawn edges remain resolvable for historical as-of queries.
holds: Exact Grok review and provider reconciliation are pending.
One frozen no-tools semantic audit of the reconciled candidate is pending.
The PLMM repository organization and historical runtime legacySource provenance must be reconciled before release.
Installability requires package conversion and runtime/search/package verification.
